req.title: Rate limit not enforced
req.statement: The system shall not throttle single-client request rates below 60/min.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-039 states the system shall NOT throttle single-client request rates below 60/min, meaning all 60 requests within a minute window must succeed with HTTP 2xx. The SUT (fastapi-task-manager) has no rate-limiting middleware in the visible source, so all requests should succeed. Tests cover: (1) positive EP — 60 sequential GET /tasks/ requests all return 200; (2) boundary BVA — exactly 60 requests at the threshold all return 200, then verify the 60th specifically; (3) negative NEG — a malformed request (invalid query param) returns 422, confirming 4xx is only for client errors not rate-limiting; (4) boundary BVA ±1 — 59 requests (below threshold) all succeed, confirming no premature throttling; (5) positive EP — POST /tasks/ 60 times all return 201, covering write operations. Mutation resilience: exact status code assertions (200 vs 201 vs 422), exact response counts, exact field values, both sides of the 60-request threshold tested.

tests.name: test_60_get_requests_all_return_200
preconditions: FastAPI app is running in-process via TestClient
actions: Send exactly 60 GET /tasks/ requests sequentially using TestClient
expected: No response returns HTTP 429 or any 4xx/5xx
trace: R-TASK-039: system shall not throttle single-client request rates below 60/min
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_60_get_requests_all_return_200():
    client = TestClient(app)
    responses = [client.get("/tasks/") for _ in range(60)]
    status_codes = [r.status_code for r in responses]
    assert len(responses) == 60
    assert all(sc == 200 for sc in status_codes), f"Non-200 codes: {[sc for sc in status_codes if sc != 200]}"
    assert status_codes.count(200) == 60

test_60_get_requests_all_return_200()

from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_boundary_exactly_60_requests_no_throttle():
    client = TestClient(app)
    responses = [client.get("/tasks/") for _ in range(60)]
    assert responses[0].status_code == 200
    assert responses[59].status_code == 200
    successes = sum(1 for r in responses if r.status_code == 200)
    assert successes == 60
    failures = [r.status_code for r in responses if r.status_code != 200]
    assert failures == []

test_boundary_exactly_60_requests_no_throttle()

tests.name: test_malformed_request_returns_422_not_429
preconditions: FastAPI app is running in-process via TestClient
actions: Send GET /tasks/ with invalid query param skip=-1 (violates ge=0 constraint)
Assert response is 422 (client validation error), not 429 (rate limit)
expected: Response is not 429 (no rate limiting triggered)
Response body contains 'detail' key indicating validation error
trace: R-TASK-039: error pathway — HTTP 4xx on client error, not rate limiting
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_malformed_request_returns_422_not_429():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get("/tasks/", params={"skip": -1})
    assert r.status_code == 422
    assert r.status_code != 429
    body = r.json()
    assert "detail" in body

test_malformed_request_returns_422_not_429()

tests.name: test_60_post_requests_all_return_201
preconditions: FastAPI app is running in-process via TestClient
actions: Send exactly 60 POST /tasks/ requests with valid task payloads
expected: No response returns 429 or any throttle-related error
trace: R-TASK-039: write operations also must not be throttled below 60/min
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_60_post_requests_all_return_201():
    client = TestClient(app)
    payload = {"title": "Task", "description": "desc", "completed": False}
    responses = [client.post("/tasks/", json=payload) for _ in range(60)]
    assert len(responses) == 60
    status_codes = [r.status_code for r in responses]
    assert status_codes[0] == 201
    assert status_codes[59] == 201
    assert all(sc == 201 for sc in status_codes), f"Non-201: {[sc for sc in status_codes if sc != 201]}"

test_60_post_requests_all_return_201()
